summary: I read all 14 members and the targets of the 29 weak links. Pattern: the Differential Equations hub and Technical Diagram Standard, Hardens, Threshold Conatus, Skills, and Striatum links each had a sentence on one page that only needed a name (18 labels), and 11 had no reason on either page (Surfaces to Modes, Palace Speaks to STIGMERGY, DE to DSP Frameworks, and Biomechanical Synthesis to Granular Synthesis, Retrospective Delay, Frequency-Time Duality, Dispersion, Endosymbiosis, Latent Error, Particle Synthesis, plus the haiku duplicate). Biomechanical Synthesis carried nine unsaid fan-out links, only two of which (Neural Granular Synthesis, Compressor Design) hold a real sentence. Several pairs carry two links (APO with Biomechanical Synthesis, Striatum, Scale-Stratified Identity; Pheromone Trail with Palace as Context Injection System; Bessel with Differential Equations); I flagged the duplicates I did not own. Could not settle: whether Biomechanical Synthesis to Frequency-Time Duality is a real kinship (the 20 Hz rate-becomes-pitch crossing) that deserves a later weave, and whether Latent Error fits the Differential Equations hub beyond a loose PID echo.
